$Comment: The rarest thing the trainer's daily tribute turns up, and by a wide margin the best thing in it: the bo staff an adept of the deep disciplines carried, the same one the trainer still holds. Parent brings in everything Weapon_Staff_Bo_Wood has (its swings, model, icon and durability) and only the four lines below differ, which is the cheapest way to ship a flavoured copy of a base-game item. Recipe is deliberately NOT inherited by Parent, so it cannot be crafted and only the tribute table pays it out. Utility.StatModifiers is where a HELD weapon's stats belong: the engine reads a Utility block only off an accessory-slot item, so these are applied for a held weapon by the equip bridge instead. Compatible stays true so the staff behaves as the base one does everywhere else. THE THREE STATS. DamageBonus_Physical, CommonLib's Physical damage stat and the damage type the Staves skill raises (its Mmo_Damage_Types tag), adds whole percent points (80 is +80%) to every Physical hit while the staff is held, its swings included, and an item's own stats count only while it is held, so it does nothing from a pack or a chest; name another type's DamageBonus_<Type> to move the bonus, or the every-type DamageBonus to have it apply to every hit. Mana and Health are the engine's own player stats, the same pair a chestplate adds to, flat points added to the wielder while it is held. To change how often the staff appears, edit the Chance on its Roll in Lootables/Mmo_Mastery_Offering.json rather than anything here. Tags.ZigLevel asks for Staves 40 to hold it (the best level the player ever reached), behind MMO Skill Tree's Gear levels switch (Tags.ZigLevelFeature); gear a player already had when gear levels arrived keeps working for them, and a server owner frees or retunes it with a ZigLevel group gate in mods/ziggfreedcommon/use-gates.json.
